packageRules.description: This repo dogfoods couch-kit — only manage @couch-kit/* dependencies.

Track every @couch-kit package, grouped into a single PR. Matched by scope rather than by name so a new package (display and runtime were both missed by the old list) is picked up without editing this file.
Auto-merge non-major @couch-kit updates once CI passes; majors are held for manual review.
